rationale.consistency: Flag wiring, MutuallyExclusive checks, FlagErrorf and warning output match surrounding code; but the requested helpers were not added to git.Client, where CheckoutBranch/Pull live.
rationale.edge_cases: Blank path, --checkout requirement, --list exclusion, relative-to-absolute, symlink/non-dir, same-repo and foreign-repo targets, and cross-repo remote selection are all handled.
rationale.scope: Delivers the feature, but swaps localBranchExists (show-ref) for HasLocalBranch (rev-parse) in unrelated non-worktree pr checkout paths, and skips the required git-client helper.
rationale.readability: Clear WorktreeTarget struct and doc comments; WorktreeCheckoutCommands returning a (cmds, branchExists) pair is slightly awkward but understandable.
rationale.robustness: No panics; path validated before any API calls; ff-only pull failure downgraded to a warning as in the existing flow; spaces in paths pass as one argument.
rationale.maintainability: Worktree resolution and command generation are centralised in pr/shared, removing duplication, but raw argv slices instead of typed git.Client methods keep the two commands coupled to string construction.
